tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rta mgrin snying po don sbyor gyi dbang chen zur 'debs bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru h+ya grī bā ya/

rta mgrin snying po don sbyor rtsa dbang la gter chen stag sham rdo rje'i zab gter rdzogs chen snying po don sbyor las 'byung ba'i lha dbang sogs sbyor ba stag sham nyid nas rim par phyag bzhes mdzad par snang bas de ltar byed na gshom gyi skabs su'ang lha tsak tshang ba sogs 'og nas 'byung ba rnams nye bar bsdogs/ dbang dngos gzhi'i rdo rje slob dpon dbang gi mjug khyed rang la thim pas gnyis su med par mos mdzod/ ces pa'i mtshams su/ de'i rjes su 'brel bar lhag pa'i lha'i sgom bzlas kyi nus byin rten 'brel khyad par can rgyud la bzhag pa'i slad du gud sbas lha sngags rgyan chas rnams kyi dbang bskur ba yin pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon dang dbyer med pa mdun bskyed dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las ye shes kyi phyag rgya mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas so sor thim pas rta mchog gtso 'khor rnams dang gnyis su med pa'i gzi brjid stobs kyi sku mchog dngos su grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thog mar rta mgrin sku thogs la/ hrī: yi dam dbang drag rta mchog dpal: snang stong rig pa'i ye shes lha: ye nas shes rig dbang bskur bas: ye shes rang gsal dbang thob shog: hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+rī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: ra tsa hri ya a bhi ṣiñca āḥhūm̐: de nas phag mo'i sku thogs la/ baṃ: snang ba'i ngo bo bde chen mo: ye nas ma bcos lhun gyis grub: phyag rgya chen mo'i dbang bskur bas: bde stong gnyis med lhan cig gyur: oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñca āḥhūm̐: de nas dbang chen rigs bzhi yab yum thogs la 'di skad do// hrī: badz+ra dbang chen rdo rje'i sku: rdo rje phag mo gnyis med rol: zhi mdzad lha yi dbang bskur bas: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i dbang thob shog:

oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ṝ wa badz+ra bhā ra hī a bhi ṣiñca āḥhūm̐: hrī: rin chen dbang chen yid bzhin sku: rin chen phag mo gnyis med rol: rgyas mdzad lha yi dbang bskur bas: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i dbang thob shog: hrīḥrat+na kro ta h+ya gh+ṝ wa rat+na bhā ra hī a bhi ṣiñca āḥhūm̐: hrī: pad+ma dbang chen chags pa'i bdag: pad+ma phag mo gnyis med rol: dbang mdzad lha yi dbang bskur bas: khams gsum dbang sdud dbang thob shog: āḥpad+ma kro ta h+ya gh+ṝ wa pad+ma bhā ra hī a bhi ṣiñca āḥhūm̐: hrī: karma dbang chen las kyi bdag: karma phag mo gnyis med rol: drag po'i lha yi dbang bskur bas: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: hūm̐ karma ko ta h+ya gh+ṝ wā karma bhā ra hī a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas dpa' bo yab yum lnga yi sku thogs la: hrī: bdag nyid dbang chen dpral ba'i rtsa 'khor du: rdo rje dpa' bo yab yum bde chen sku: dga' ba chen po rjes su chags pa yis: phung po'i bdud 'joms sa brgyad dbang thob shog: badz+ra ḍā ka ḍā ki nī a bhi ṣiñca ā: hrī: bdag nyid dbang chen mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor du: rat+na dpa' bo yab yum snang stong sku: dga' ba rab dga' rjes su chags pa yis: lha bu'i bdud 'joms sa dgu'i dbang thob shog: rat+na ḍā ka ḍā ki nī a bhi ṣiñca ā: hrī: bdag nyid dbang chen lte ba'i rtsa 'khor du: pad+ma dpa' bo yab yum dbang bskur bas: gtum mo bde drod rang 'bar rjes su chags: thabs las rtsal rdzogs sa bcu'i dbang thob shog: pad+ma ḍā ka ḍā ki nī a bhi ṣiñca ā: hrī: bdag nyid dbang chen gsang gnas rtsa 'khor du: karma dpa' bo yab yum dbang bskur bas: mchog dga' chen po rjes su chags pa yis: nyon mongs bdud 'joms pad+ma can thob shog: karma ḍā ka ḍā ki nī a bhi ṣiñca ā: hrī: bdag nyid dbang chen thugs ka'i rtsa 'khor du: bhud+dha dpa' bo yab yum dbang bskur bas:

lhan cig skyes dga' rjes su chags pa yis: 'chi bdag bdud 'joms rdo rje 'dzin thob shog: bhud+dha ḍā ka ḍā ki nī a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas sgo ma bzhi dang mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi'i dbang bskur ba ni: dza: kha gdong dkar mo las byed lcags kyu 'dzin: shar sgo skyong ma zhi ba'i dbang bskur bas: 'gugs pa'i las rnams 'grub pa'i dbang thob shog: badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥdzaḥ.a bhi ṣiñca āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: phag gdong ser mo las byed zhags pa 'dzin: lho sgo skyong ma rgyas pa'i dbang bskur bas: 'ching ba'i las rnams 'grub pa'i dbang thob shog: rat+na pā sha hūm̐ hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: baṃ: khyi gdong dmar mo las byed lcags sgrog 'dzin: nub sgo skyong ma dbang gi dbang bskur bas: sdom dbye'i phrin las 'grub pa'i dbang thob shog: pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ baṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: ho: 'ug gdong ljang mo las byed dril bu 'dzin: byang sgo skyong ma drag po'i dbang bskur bas: myos byed drag po bsgral ba'i dbang thob shog: karma ghān+ḍe ho ho a bhi ṣiñca ā: hrī: lha mo rten byed dkar ser phyed gzugs 'dzin: zhi rgyas ldan pa rtag par lta ba dag: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: stong nyid phyag rgya chen po'i dbang thob shog: hrī: lha mo pho nya ser dmar phyed gzugs 'dzin: rgyas dbang ldan pa chad par lta ba dag: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rtsa rlung zung 'jug thabs lam dbang thob shog: hrī: lha mo mche ma ljang dmar phyed gzugs 'dzin: dbang drag ldan pa mtshan mar lta ba dag: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: thabs mchog mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dbang thob shog: hrī: lha mo 'joms ma ljang dkar phyed gzugs 'dzin: zhi drag ldan pa bdag 'dzin rtog pa dag: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: shes rab zab rgya thig le'i dbang thob shog: hriṃ hriṃ hriṃ hriṃḥmu dra a bhi ṣiñca āḥhūm̐:

bgrang phreng gtad la/ hrī: gsang sngags ma nyams chu bo'i rgyun: 'od zer nyams med nyi zla'i zer: dmigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor shing rta'i 'gros: sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi ngang: skal ldan bu yis mchog thob shog: mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros/ zhal nas thon/ khyod rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs srog hrīḥyig gi mthar 'khod par mos la gsang sngags kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ snying po'i rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug / dur khrod 'bar ba'i chas rnams dang phyag mtshan rnams phul bas mnga' gsol bas mthu stobs gzi byin lhag par 'bar bar mos shig / dur khrod chas brgyad gnas so sor sbyin pa'i tshul byas la/ hūm̐ hrī: sngon tshe ru tra bsgral pa'i dpa' bo'i chas: thod skam dbu rgyan skye med chos kyi sku: dpal gyi rtags gsum tshom bu longs spyod rdzogs: thod rlon lnga bcu bdud 'dul sprul pa'i sku: glang chen zhing stag sbrul lnga bla med sku: me dpung rus rgyan dregs 'joms ngo bo nyid: sku lnga lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang bskur bas: dpal chen yongs rdzogs rtags kyi dbang thob shog: de nas phyag mtshan drug gtad la/ hrī: rdo rje 'bar ba mi shigs stong pa nyid: dril bu thabs shes 'gro ba gnyid las slong: kha ṭ+wāṃ dug gsum rtsad gcod 'khor ba stongs: thod khrag ye shes dngos grub char ltar 'beb: rgyu zhags 'khor ba log bcings dregs pa 'dul: lcags sgrog ma rig kun bsdoms khams gsum 'chings: dpal chen phrin las yongs rdzogs dbang bskur bas: che btsan 'gran bral he ru ka thob shog: de nas yum sogs gri thod kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ hrī: nyon mongs rtsad gcod gri gug ye shes mtshon: 'dod chags gnas dag thod khrag rjes chags che: yab yum thabs shes bde rol phyag rgya'i gar: dpa' bo dpa' mo'i chas rdzogs pas: stobs bcu'i tshul ldan rta phag dbang thob shog:

ces me tog 'thor la/ oṃ 'grub par gyur cig: rta phag yab yum dang gnyis su med pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig: de nas dbang gzhung gi/ mtha' rten du brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rjes su gnang ba sogs la 'jug go /zhes pa'ang brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ltar rtsa gsum lha dbang chen mo las gu ṇas gud du bskol ba dge legs 'phel// //
